name: Canary Wharf Shopping Malls and Estate map (store guide), November 2025
what_it_shows: 2 pages, vector (Adobe Illustrator), north arrow, no scale. Page 1 'Shopping Malls': schematic plan of all five malls, colour coded (Cabot Place teal, Canada Place red, Churchill Place green, Crossrail Place purple, Jubilee Place orange) plus Park Pavilion and One Canada Square Lobby, on a lettered grid A-Q x 1-16. Level numbers are shown as circled badges: Cabot Place has separate insets for levels 0, 1 and 2 beside the -1 mall plan; badges -1, -2 and -3 mark parts of Crossrail Place, Jubilee Place and the Canada Place area, and 0 marks street entrances (read from a low-resolution render; check each badge at full resolution before use). Shows every shop unit with name, lifts, escalators, toilets, accessible toilets (with hoist), baby change, prayer room, ATMs, car park payment points, the Canary Wharf DLR ticket concourse and DLR platforms inside Cabot Place, West India Quay and Heron Quays DLR, Jubilee line entrances (Jubilee Plaza, Montgomery Square), Elizabeth line at Crossrail Place, links such as Adams Plaza Bridge, Canada Walk, Jubilee Walk, Bellmouth Passage, and red notes for 'access to Crossrail Place level -1 from Canada Place via Adams Plaza' and 'lift to K1/-4 Cabot Place car park'. Key says 'Floor level indicator 0 equals street level'. A directory lists about 300 shops, restaurants, cafes, services with grid refs. Page 2 'Canary Wharf Estate': street-level estate plan, grid A-J x 1-23, from Westferry Circus to Wood Wharf, building addresses, street retail, office tenants, estate residential, cycle hire, bus stops, taxi ranks, Thames Clippers pier.
format: PDF 2 pages, 1842x2806 pt, vector artwork with outlined text (pdftotext returns nothing)
licence_or_terms: Credit on sheet: 'Design Paul Anthony, Ravenshaw Studios Limited. (c) Copyright Ravenshaw Studios Limited and Paul & Linda Anthony 2025'. Plus canarywharf.com website terms (archived 2026-08-05, https://web.archive.org/web/20260805150550/https://canarywharf.com/terms-conditions/): all rights reserved by Canary Wharf Group plc; you may print and download, but not modify or reproduce without prior written consent. No open licence.

name: Living Map style sheet and vector tile sources for Canary Wharf
what_it_shows: Mapbox GL style 'canary_wharf-living-map-platform-prod' (version 8, 256 layers, 160 KB). Sources: 'lm' vector tiles https://prod.cdn.livingmap.com/tiles/canary_wharf/{z}/{x}/{y}.pbf?lang=en-GB (zoom 0-19, source-layers 'indoor' and 'outdoor'); 'lm_osm' basemap https://prod.cdn.livingmap.com/canary_wharf_basemap/{z}/{x}/{y} (OSM, zoom 0-16). Indoor feature model from the layer filters: category room/unit/barrier/object/amenity/route; types floor, corridor, unenclosed_area, vista (open to below), back_of_house, seating_area, section; circulation types lift, escalator, stairs, steps, ramp, travelator; barrier types wall, partition, door, threshold, security; objects column, structure, planter, water_feature; transport stops and stations, gates/platforms; emergency and sensor icons; properties include name, local_rank, landmark, closed, brunnel (tunnel/bridge), oneway, icon_id. Routes are drawn from client-side GeoJSON returned by a POST routing call, so no routing graph is exposed.
